scenarios.title: Baseline Ambulance Route via Puente de Piedra
scenarios.briefing: Route cleared for AMBULANCE to ZONE_NORTH_RESIDENTIAL with ETA of 5.9 minutes covering 3.93 km with 100.0% route reliability. All assigned road segments and bridgeheads report nominal surface conditions without active flood threats.

scenarios.title: Heavy Rain (45 mm/h) Predictive Detour via Puente de Santiago
scenarios.briefing: Route cleared for AMBULANCE to ZONE_NORTH_RESIDENTIAL with ETA of 6.6 minutes covering 4.38 km with 99.8% route reliability. Predictive flood routing active with +0.7 min detour to bypass high risk bridgehead crossings.

scenarios.title: Physical Submersion Detour via Puente de Santiago
scenarios.briefing: Route cleared for AMBULANCE to ZONE_NORTH_RESIDENTIAL with ETA of 6.6 minutes covering 4.38 km with 100.0% route reliability. Transit diverted to avoid submerged or blocked infrastructure along the primary corridor.

scenarios.title: Island Cutoff - Land Vehicles Impassable, Boat Dispatch
scenarios.briefing: Route cleared for RESCUE_BOAT to ZONE_ISLAND_COMMUNITY along river corridor with ETA of 5.3 minutes covering 0.67 km with 99.2% route reliability. All assigned river corridors report nominal navigable flow conditions without active debris hazards.
